title: alchemilla arvensis proles microcarpa
intro: Alchemilla arvensis proles microcarpa, commonly known as the small-leaved lady's mantle, is a subspecies of the perennial herb Alchemilla arvensis. The plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla arvensis proles microcarpa include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and astringent actions, which may help to reduce swelling, relieve muscle cramps, and protect mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, tannins, and saponins, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential uses.
